# East Anglia AI Services

> Specialist AI automation consultancy delivering custom AI agents, workflow automation, predictive intelligence, LLM integration, data pipelines and AI ops for small and medium businesses across Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire and Essex (UK). Founded and run by Petar Petkov.

East Anglia AI Services (EAAIS) builds and deploys production AI systems for SMEs — not generic software, but automation designed around how a specific business already works. Typical engagements: invoice-processing automation, AI voice agents for customer service, predictive demand forecasting, LLM-powered chatbots grounded in a company's own documents, and continuous AI ops monitoring for deployed models. Projects typically go from discovery to a live system in a matter of weeks. Contact: info@eastangliaaiservices.co.uk, +44 7466 951175.

## Service area

Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, Essex — including Norwich, Ipswich, Cambridge, Colchester, Peterborough, Bury St Edmunds, Chelmsford and King's Lynn. Remote delivery is available UK-wide.
